assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.intro: I can look through your tasks, notes, meetings, files and partners. If something should change, I propose it to you first.
assistant.introRecord: “{title}” is open, so I can help with it. If something should change, I propose it to you first.
assistant.welcomeNote: My proposals arrive as cards you accept, edit or reject. They also wait in the Inbox.
assistant.welcomeReadOnly: The project is archived: I answer questions but propose no changes.
assistant.placeholder: Ask Claude something or ask for help…
assistant.placeholderOff: Works here once AI is connected
assistant.footer: Claude only proposes; you approve every change.
assistant.footerReadOnly: The project is archived; Claude only reads and answers.

off.title: The assistant is not connected yet
off.body: Once ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is added, Claude works here: it sees your screen, searches, and prepares proposals for you.
off.memory: Meanwhile you can fill in the project glossary under Memory.

errors.not_configured: AI is not connected yet. It works once ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is added.
errors.disabled: AI is switched off in Settings.
errors.cap_reached: This month's AI budget is used up. You can change the cap in Settings.
errors.refused: Claude declined this request. Could you rephrase it and try again?
errors.failed: AI could not answer right now. Could you try again in a moment?
errors.too_large: This request is too large for AI. Could you pick a smaller part?
errors.ai_off: This item is kept away from AI; it is never sent to Claude.
errors.child_data: This message may contain personal data about a child, so it was not sent to Claude.
errors.offline: You are offline. Could you try again once you are connected?
